description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Soft-top Snaps that screw into the side body of the Samurai.
There are 5 on each side of the bed so this will do one complete side.
Non-Corrosive Coating
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 5 – Snaps w/Threaded Posts for Samurai Bodyside
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
